SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) LIKE '%bipolar%'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
ORDER BY concept_name

I'll use the broad "Bipolar disorder" concept (436665) and its descendants to capture the full cohort, then find co-occurring substance-use diagnoses using the OMOP concept hierarchy.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Count distinct bipolar patients (bipolar disorder + all descendants)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS bipolar_patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 436665
)

content.text: 24,194 bipolar patients. Now the substance-use co-occurrence. Let me find substance-use disorder diagnoses within this cohort, rolled up to their major categories.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH bp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 436665
  )
),
sud_cat AS (
  SELECT 4218224 AS cat_id, 'Alcohol-related disorder' AS cat_name UNION ALL
  SELECT 37312127, 'Opioid-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 439999, 'Cocaine-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4147829, 'Cannabis-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4149320, 'Sedative-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 40483159, 'Stimulant-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4103528, 'Nicotine dependence' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4084963, 'Hallucinogen-related disorder' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4143786, 'Inhalant-related disorder'
)
SELECT c.cat_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_bipolar_patients
FROM sud_cat c
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = c.cat_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN bp ON bp.person_id = co.person_id
GROUP BY c.cat_name
ORDER BY n_bipolar_patients DESC
